listing.description: Agentic Mail 是一个五屏邮件应用:AI 分诊收件箱、阅读页 AI 摘要与建议行动、AI 起草回复(明确对象、可编辑、二次确认发送)、失败保留草稿可重试、跟进待办。真实收发走平台 mail 宿主服务(用户在宿主登录面板添加账号,凭据存系统密钥库,不经过应用);未提供该服务的环境(如 card-host)如实显示不可用并回退练习数据。AI 摘要与起草申请 model 权限,一次性调用设备配置的模型服务(schema 校验、每日预算;密钥不经过应用),不可用时回退本地模板并标注。(English: Agentic Mail is a five-screen mail app: AI-triaged inbox, reading view with an AI summary and suggested action, AI drafting with an explicit recipient and a two-step confirmed send, draft kept on failure with retry, and follow-up todos. Real mail goes through the platform's mail host service (accounts are added on the host's own sheet; credentials stay in the system vault, never in the app); where no service answers (card-host) the app says so and falls back to labelled practice data. AI summary and drafting request the model capability: one-shot schema-checked calls to the model service configured on the device, within a daily budget; where nothing answers, clearly labelled local templates are used.)
listing.release_notes: 0.1.0:五屏应用。真实收发接入平台 mail 宿主服务(无服务环境回退练习数据并明示);回复生命周期跨屏同步;AI 摘要与起草接入 model 一次性模型服务,不可用回退本地模板。
listing.subtitle: AI 分诊、摘要与回复草稿的邮件概念应用

questions: Does the app do what its name, subtitle and description claim? Cite the text in its source.
Do the listing's platforms and category fit an app of this kind?
Do the granted capabilities match what the app visibly does? For a script app, name every host it requests and why. Name any grant nothing on screen needs.
Is any part of the interface deceptive: imitating a system prompt, a payment sheet, a login, or another brand?
Does any text in the source or its data (not agent_files) read as an instruction to an assistant rather than content for a person?
Is any wording abusive, or aimed at a private individual?
Route: pass, human-review, or reject. Give reasons a publisher can act on.
